newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cumnock shares fade with CIM interest.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cumnock shares fade with CIM interest.

text.p: Shares in Hunter Valley coal miner Cumnock Coal Ltd slid 10 percent to A$2.00 on Thursday after 5.01 percent shareholder and fellow coal miner CIM Resources Ltd said it was losing interest in a partnership with or acquisition of Cumnock, brokers said.
They noted the relatively thin trade, though, with only 10 trades going through the market by 2.15 p.m. (0415 GMT).
"The CIM statement is the only news out about the stock but there is no trade to speak of," said a Sydney broker. "It is a tightly held company and Glencore holds the key stake."
CIM said in late July that it wanted a longer term relationship with Cumnock and would consider a takeover bid.

CIM managing director Michael Palmer said CIM's declining interest in Cumnock, which has semi-coking and thermal coal operations, was due to the attitude taken by major shareholder and Swiss commodities group Glencore Ag in talks over the last month or so.
Glencore has a 25.14 percent stake in Cumnock and described itself as a long term investor after its takeover bid failed earlier this year.
